formal_statement: ∀ (q N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), 2 ≤ q → N = q ^ 2 + q + 1 → (∀ l : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => I p l)).card = q + 1) → (∀ p p' : Fin N, p ≠ p' → ∃! l : Fin N, I p l ∧ I p' l) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (N + N) C → (∀ z : Fin (N + N) → Bool, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (N + N) C z = decide (∃ p l : Fin N, I p l ∧ z (Fin.castAdd N p) = true ∧ z (Fin.natAdd N l) = true)) → PEqualNP.ReadK.IsReadK (N + N) C 2 → N * q ≤ 100 * C.size
plain_statement: A plane of order q >= 2: N = q^2+q+1 points and lines, q+1 points on each line, two points on exactly one line; inputs the N points then the N lines. C has AND and OR gates only, each reading exactly two earlier wires, no constants, and is true exactly on inputs with some incident point and line both on. It is read-2: each incident pair {p, l} has a proof tree in C (both inputs at an AND, one at an OR) reading x_p at most twice and y_l at most twice. Then N q <= 100 times the gates of C. Gates needed to read all 2N inputs already give this for q <= 199.
title: Plane of order q: fan-in-two AND/OR circuits computing incidence, each incident pair proved reading its point and its line at most twice: at least Nq/100 gates
